Re: Claim C-1460
Our client: Monica Stout
Date of loss: 5-17-24
Dear Claims Representative:
This firm represents the individual injured in the side-impact collision that occurred at an intersection involving your insured.
Please direct all further communication regarding this matter to our office. Do not contact our client directly, whether by
telephone, mail, email, or in person, and refer any inquiries from your insured or their representatives to us as well.
Kindly provide the bodily injury and property damage liability limits of every policy that may apply to this loss, including any
umbrella or excess coverage, along with a copy of the declarations page for each. Please also confirm the claim number assigned
to this matter and the name of the adjuster handling the file.
We further request that your comapny preserve all evidence relating to the incident. This includes photographs, vehicle data and
event recorder information, dash camera footage, recorded statements, claim notes, repair estimates, and any surveillance or
investigative materials. Please also instruct your insured to preserve their vehicle, mobile device records, and any related
documentation until this matter is resolved.
Please acknowledge receipt of this letter within fourteen days.
Sincerely,
Jennifer Black
Montoya & Solis Law Group
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
